versions.name: Rifle Shooting
versions.description: Handle a rifle safely on a supervised range, then work on aiming, breathing, trigger control and follow-through until your shots group tightly with a rimfire, air, or muzzleloading rifle.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
